diff --git a/clients/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/internals/CommitRequestManager.java b/clients/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/internals/CommitRequestManager.java
index e6606d975d..916d859bc2 100644
--- a/clients/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/internals/CommitRequestManager.java
+++ b/clients/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/clients/consumer/internals/CommitRequestManager.java
@@ -968,10 +968,17 @@ public class CommitRequestManager implements RequestManager, MemberStateListener

          * Partitions to get committed offsets for.

+        public Map<Uuid, String> topicNamesCache;
